title: One platform for a safe, focused classroom
intro: As the official Blocksi partner for Australia and New Zealand, we deploy and manage the complete Blocksi platform for schools. It brings web filtering, classroom management, and student safety together in a single cloud console that runs across every device your students use.

stats.label: AI early warning for student safety

pillars.title: AI content filtering
pillars.desc: Smart, adaptive filtering built specifically for K-12, so students reach what helps them learn and nothing that does not.
points: AI adaptive YouTube and web filtering tuned for the classroom
Full traffic decryption with unlimited bandwidth
Cloud based, with agents for ChromeOS, macOS, iOS, Windows, and Android
Fast to deploy and low maintenance across the whole fleet

pillars.title: Classroom management
pillars.desc: A teaching tool that goes well beyond simple screen monitoring, giving teachers real control of the room.
points: Real time screen monitoring for every student in the class
Secure URL based test and kiosk mode
Freeze or lock student screens remotely
Plagiarism checks and academic integrity tools
Live per session analytics, plus video conferencing and screen sharing

pillars.title: Student & school safety
pillars.desc: A round the clock early warning system that helps schools spot risk before it becomes harm.
points: 24/7/365 AI scanning across Google Workspace and Outlook
Emails, images, and documents analysed for concerning content
Behaviour patterns tracked with smart, targeted alerts
Every AI detection reviewed by a human safety expert before the school is notified

roles.desc: Set robust browsing policy across the district and cut out the distractions that pull students off task.
Lead the class with confidence, keep every student engaged, and run lessons without fighting the screen.
Support your system admins and schools, curating online content that lifts learning and blocks the harmful.
Stay connected to your child's learning and safety, at school and at home.

extras.title: AI formative quizzes
extras.desc: Generate interactive quizzes by subject, topic, and language, then track performance and progress over time.

extras.title: 25+ LMS integrations
extras.desc: Locked study kiosks and imports for Canvas, EdPuzzle, Google Classroom, and more.

extras.title: Device anti-theft
extras.desc: Geolocation tracking, remote lock, and data wipe to protect missing or stolen devices.

extras.title: Multi-OS 1:1 management
extras.desc: One unified platform managing a mixed fleet of student devices across every operating system.
